title: Undoing a Mess
text: Jordan's little brother could not wait for the party and unwrapped every single present hours before the guests arrived, tearing the paper before anyone even said his name. Wrapping paper covered the floor, and the bows had been pulled loose from every box. Jordan groaned, gathered fresh paper and tape, and carefully rewrapped each gift so it looked untouched by the time guests walked through the door. Their parents never noticed a thing, and Jordan's brother promised to wait next time. Jordan felt proud of fixing the mess so quickly and kept the secret between just the two of them.
